caption: Min: vertical and horizontal stripes where only the dimmer of the two counts - lit only where both cross: dots
why: Cutting one pattern by another - showing a pattern only where a second one allows - is the opposite of laying them together. Min gives the smaller of two numbers: a pixel is only as bright as the dimmer pattern there, so only where both are bright does anything show.
Its neighbours: Multiply also masks, but darkens the middle values more; Max keeps the brighter; Min keeps the dimmer - an intersection.
steps: A **Wave** along **Coords** `u` (4 cycles, scrolling) is **a**: vertical stripes.
A Wave along `v` (2 cycles) is **b**: horizontal stripes.
Min gives the smaller of the two: only where both stripes are lit is the pixel lit - dots where they cross.
The result is the **Palette**'s brightness; the colour follows `u`.
